in_marathi.name: Tapasya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tapasya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tapasya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tapas' which means 'Heat'. This name signifies the process of self-discipline, penance and austerity that an individual undergoes to attain spiritual growth and purification.
